questions: Should the threshold check be 'both stores have combined sales exceeding a specified threshold' (sum > 200) or 'both stores exceed the sales threshold' (each > 200)?
If no categories meet the threshold, should the Euclidean distance be 0.0 or NaN/None?
Are the input series guaranteed to have the same index order and length, and must they be aligned by index? Or should we assume they are already aligned to CATEGORIES?
Should the Euclidean distance be computed over the original sales values or over some transformed values (e.g., normalized)?
If a category has exactly 200 sales for one or both stores, does it count as 'exceeding' the threshold?
Should the bar plot include only categories where both stores exceed threshold, or all categories with at least one store above threshold?
Is the Euclidean distance computed using the same subset of categories that are plotted, or over all categories regardless of threshold?
